content.rendered:
Buy your extended warranty coverage when you purchase your laser cap and save over 45%. This is the only time you can claim this warranty offer discount.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

This purchase extends the warranty of your Kiierr Laser Cap from TWO (2) years to FIVE (5) years.

•Your warranty is non-transferable. Only the ORIGINAL PURCHASER can add the extended warranty.
•The extended warranty is subject to the same terms as your original warranty except for the fact that it extends coverage to FIVE years total from the original purchase date of your product.
•3-year extended warranty purchased after 45 days of purchase will not be honored.

excerpt.rendered: Extend your standard two year warranty This gives you access to: • An additional 3 years warranty coverage (Total of 5 years) • Comprehensive repair coverage (laser cap and battery) • No charge product replacement if your cap becomes defective • No shipping charge if you reside in the USA • Access to our helpful industry-leading customer support Buy your extended warranty coverage when you purchase with your laser cap and save 45%, otherwise you will pay full price if you buy the extended warranty after you purchase your laser cap.
